%@ meta id=hsr_timetable_resilience family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: High-Speed Railway Timetable Resilience
%@ desc :: Mixed Integer Linear Programming model for the Timetable Rescheduling Problem (TRP) on High-Speed Railways (HSR) after disruptions, considering track outage, track recovery, station recovery, and dynamic traffic demand.
%@ index T ordered=1 cyclic=0 :: Time periods.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ index TR ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Train routes.
%@ param d shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_demand :: Dynamic traffic demand.
%@ param c shape=TR kind=scalar domain=train_capacity :: Train capacity.
%@ param t shape=TR kind=scalar domain=travel_time :: Travel time between stations for each train route.
%@ param r shape=T kind=scalar domain=recovery_time :: Time required for track and station recovery.
%@ var x shape=T,TR domain=binary role=primary drole=scheduling lo=- hi=- :: Binary variable indicating whether a train is scheduled on a route at a given time.
%@ var y shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=recovery lo=- hi=- :: Binary variable indicating whether a station is recovered at a given time.
%@ var z shape=T kind=scalar domain=non_negative role=auxiliary drole=auxiliary_linearization lo=- hi=- :: Auxiliary variable for calculating resilience.
%@ obj sense=max name=resilience combination=sum :: Maximize the resilience of the HSR network by minimizing the difference between the scheduled and original timetables.
%@ con scheduling kind=scheduling domain=scheduling indicator=- :: Ensure that each train is scheduled at most once on each route.
%@ con recovery kind=recovery domain=recovery indicator=- :: Ensure that each station is recovered before it can be used.
%@ con capacity kind=capacity domain=capacity indicator=- :: Ensure that the total number of passengers on each train does not exceed its capacity.
%@ con demand kind=demand domain=demand indicator=- :: Ensure that the scheduled trains meet the dynamic traffic demand.
\begin{align}
  \max\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} z_{t} \tag{resilience} \\
  & \sum_{tr \in \mathcal{TR}} x_{t,tr} \le 1 \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{scheduling} \\
  & y_{t,s} \ge y_{t-1,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{recovery} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{tr \in \mathcal{TR}} c_{tr} \cdot x_{t,tr} \le \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} d_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{capacity} \\
  & \sum_{tr \in \mathcal{TR}} x_{t,tr} \ge \frac{d_{t,s}}{c_{tr}} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{demand} \\
  & z_{t} \ge \sum_{tr \in \mathcal{TR}} x_{t,tr} - \sum_{tr \in \mathcal{TR}} x_{t-1,tr} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{resilience\_aux} \\
\end{align}

%@ meta id=hsr_timetable_resilience family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: HSR Timetable Resilience after Earthquakes
%@ desc :: Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) model for High-Speed Railway (HSR) timetable rescheduling after earthquakes, considering main track outage, track recovery, station recovery, and dynamic traffic demand.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Time periods.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ index R ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Railway sections (tracks).
%@ param d shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_demand :: Dynamic traffic demand after earthquake.
%@ param c shape=R kind=scalar domain=track_capacity :: Track capacity.
%@ param t_rec shape=R kind=scalar domain=recovery_time :: Track recovery time.
%@ param t_sta shape=S kind=scalar domain=recovery_time :: Station recovery time.
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=large_number :: Large number for big-M formulation.
%@ var x shape=T,R domain=binary role=primary drole=track_usage lo=- hi=- :: Track usage indicator.
%@ var y shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=station_usage lo=- hi=- :: Station usage indicator.
%@ var z shape=T,R domain=integer role=auxiliary drole=auxiliary_linearization lo=0 hi=- :: Number of trains on track.
%@ var w shape=T,S domain=integer role=auxiliary drole=auxiliary_linearization lo=0 hi=- :: Number of passengers at station.
%@ obj sense=min name=resilience combination=sum :: Minimize the total deviation from original timetable.
%@ con track_outage kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Track outage constraint.
%@ con track_recovery kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Track recovery constraint.
%@ con station_recovery kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Station recovery constraint.
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Track capacity constraint.
%@ con demand kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Dynamic traffic demand constraint.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, r \in \mathcal{R}} z_{t,r} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} w_{t,s} \tag{resilience} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} x_{t,r} \le t_rec_r \qquad \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{track_outage} \\
  & x_{t,r} \ge x_{t-1,r} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{track_recovery} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} y_{t,s} \le t_sta_s \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{station_recovery} \\
  & z_{t,r} \le c_r \cdot x_{t,r} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{capacity} \\
  & w_{t,s} \le d_{t,s} \cdot y_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{demand} \\
  & z_{t,r} \le M \cdot x_{t,r} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{big_M} \\
  & w_{t,s} \le M \cdot y_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{big_M} \\
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Reversible with lp2graph.codec.from_canonical_latex (schema 0.1.0).
%@ meta id=hsr_timetable_resilience family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: High-Speed Railway Timetable Resilience Optimization
%@ desc :: Mixed-integer linear programming model for timetable rescheduling after earthquakes, considering main track outage, track recovery, station recovery, and dynamic traffic demand.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Time periods.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ index R ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Rail tracks.
%@ param d shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_demand :: Dynamic traffic demand.
%@ param c shape=R kind=scalar domain=recovery_time :: Track recovery time.
%@ param b shape=S kind=scalar domain=recovery_time :: Station recovery time.
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=large_number :: Large number for big-M formulation.
%@ var x shape=T,R domain=binary role=primary drole=track_usage lo=- hi=- :: Track usage indicator.
%@ var y shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=station_usage lo=- hi=- :: Station usage indicator.
%@ var z shape=T,R domain=integer role=auxiliary drole=track_recovery lo=0 hi=- :: Track recovery time indicator.
%@ var w shape=T,S domain=integer role=auxiliary drole=station_recovery lo=0 hi=- :: Station recovery time indicator.
%@ var t shape=T,R domain=continuous role=primary drole=timetable lo=- hi=- :: Timetable for each track.
%@ obj sense=min name=resilience_optimization combination=sum :: Minimize the total recovery time and maximize the traffic demand satisfaction.
%@ con track_outage kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Track outage constraint.
%@ con station_outage kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Station outage constraint.
%@ con track_recovery kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Track recovery constraint.
%@ con station_recovery kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Station recovery constraint.
%@ con timetable kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Timetable constraint.
%@ con demand kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Traffic demand satisfaction constraint.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} z_{t,r} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} w_{t,s} - \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} d_{t,s} \tag{resilience\_optimization} \\
  & \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} x_{t,r} \le M \cdot (1 - z_{t,r}) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{track\_outage} \\
  & \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} y_{t,s} \le M \cdot (1 - w_{t,s}) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{station\_outage} \\
  & z_{t,r} \ge z_{t-1,r} + c \cdot x_{t,r} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{track\_recovery} \\
  & w_{t,s} \ge w_{t-1,s} + b \cdot y_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{station\_recovery} \\
  & t_{t,r} \ge t_{t-1,r} + z_{t,r} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{timetable} \\
  & \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} x_{t,r} \cdot d_{t,s} \ge d_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{demand} \\
\end{align}
